environment.description: Same plugin deployed in a hardened namespace with the following runtime characteristics: (1) Credentials are managed by HashiCorp Vault dynamic secrets engine with a max_ttl of 60s and use_limit of 1 (single-use tokens that are consumed on first pipeline execution and cannot be replayed); (2) The Kubernetes NetworkPolicy applies an egress rule restricting the pod to only communicate with the internal registry IP (10.96.44.12/32) on port 443 and the Vault agent sidecar on localhost:8200 — no other egress is permitted including DNS resolution for external hosts; (3) An OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate `K8sPipelineConfigSanitizer` validates all inbound JSON payloads to the /api/pipeline/*/config endpoint via an admission webhook sidecar (envoy filter) that strips any keys matching the regex `^(__proto__|constructor|prototype)$` at any nesting depth before the request reaches the application.

opa_gatekeeper_constraint.description: Envoy ext_authz filter strips prototype pollution keys from JSON bodies
